description.narrative: The development impact is provided through: increasing value added and job creation by scaling up advanced automotive manufacturing and expanding supply chain linkages with domestic SMEs; enhancing human capital through structured training in technical and managerial competencies, digital upskilling, and partnerships with universities and technical institutions; and reinforcing Tunisia's competitiveness as an advanced automotive manufacturing hub, encouraging further multinational entry and FDI into the sector.

The proposed IFC investment supports Marquardt GmbH (Marquardt or the Company) in financing the (i) expansion capex including equipment purchase and building and (ii) working capital needs of its automotive mechatronic and automation component production facility in Tunisia operated through its local subsidiary, Marquardt Automotive Tunisie S.a.r.l.
